name: ART Puzzle
summary:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of art with the VR game ARTPuzzle and collect jigsaw puzzles with iconic work by the most famous masters.

Explore art galleries featuring paintings by artists of various eras, genres and countries, each with its own unique atmosphere and carefully selected paintings. Thanks to the great detail of the images, you will be able to pay attention to the smallest details of the paintings and reveal the author's idea in a new way.
